name: AWS Free Plan
free_limit: New eligible AWS customers: Free account plan for up to 6 months or until AWS Free Tier credits are exhausted; $100 signup credit plus up to $100 earned through activities
watch_out: The Free account plan is a time-limited ACCOUNT offer, not an always-free VPS. It ends at 6 months or credit exhaustion, whichever comes first; AWS automatically closes the Free account and resources/data become inaccessible unless upgraded. Joining AWS Organizations upgrades to Paid and ends Free Plan credit eligibility. Some services offer separate always-free monthly usage; Paid-plan usage beyond allowances can incur charges.
